platform: Illumina HiSeq 2000 (paired-end; inserts of 170, 500 and 800 bp)
animal: a second adult, the source of the short reads used for the assembly

note: Both runs of the egg DNA library.

animal: the individual used for the assembly (one animal, Kagoshima, Japan, 2013)
note: Both paired-end libraries used for the assembly, analysed in full. The reads are deposited in the archive under the name Elysia ornata. The mate-pair libraries were excluded.
